name: Jitters' Growling Gut
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds!  I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it.

Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely.

I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
narrative.offerRewardText: You need some Crab Cakes, do you? Well I might be able to cook some up for you...

quests.name: Dusky Crab Cakes

quests.name: Return to Jitters
quests.objectiveText: Return to Jitters with the Dusky Crab Cakes.
